researchResults.title: NVIDIA launches GR00T 2 and Isaac Lab 3.0 at CoRL
researchResults.description:
NVIDIA also gave a look at how its partners, like Ambi Robotics, FieldAI, Flexion, Skild AI, RLWRLD, and more, are using these technologies. 

The post NVIDIA launches GR00T 2 and Isaac Lab 3.0 at CoRL appeared first on The Robot Report.

researchResults.title: Boston Dynamics adds wheels to Atlas humanoid to test whole-body control
researchResults.description:
Boston Dynamics combines classical motor control with whole-body reinforcement learning to power dynamic, wheeled locomotion for Atlas.

The post Boston Dynamics adds wheels to Atlas humanoid to test whole-body control appeared first on The Robot Report.

researchResults.title: Axon invests $1.2B into Skydio and becomes its U.S. public safety distributor
researchResults.description:
The partners plan to bring Skydio drones to public safety agencies across the U.S. as Axon expands its Drone as First Responder program.

The post Axon invests $1.2B into Skydio and becomes its U.S. public safety distributor appeared first on The Robot Report.

researchResults.title: How to minimize Wi-Fi roaming interruptions for autonomous mobile robots
researchResults.description:
Dedicated Wi-Fi scan architectures can improve robot mobility, reliability, and performance, says Synaptics.

The post How to minimize Wi-Fi roaming interruptions for autonomous mobile robots appeared first on The Robot Report.

researchResults.title: Adobe adds more AI to its products and launches an MCP
researchResults.description: Adobe is taking on Figma with a new prototype builder tool in Firefly.

researchResults.title: Spotify’s AI DJ gets new voices, personalities, and an option for less chatter
researchResults.description: Spotify Premium users can now customize their AI DJ with new voices with different personalities, or turn off the commentary between songs.

researchResults.title: After challenging Google’s Android with Cyanogen, its co-founder takes aim at Windows for AI era
researchResults.description: Kora is set to launch as a free-to-use alternative to Windows, targeting users who rely heavily on AI models and agents.

researchResults.title: Cyberattacks threaten to make open-source AI a little less open, Hugging Face exec warns
researchResults.description: Hugging Face executive Irene Solaiman warns that growing cyberattacks on open AI platforms could force tighter security restrictions, threatening the accessibility that makes open-source communities valuable to developers worldwide.

researchResults.title: We’re bringing Adobe’s creative and productivity tools closer to your everyday Google apps.
researchResults.description: Google and Adobe are integrating creative and productivity tools. Edit PDFs in Drive and use Adobe AI in Gemini. See what’s new in this partnership.

researchResults.title: Anthropic sets IPO price range of $70 to $78 per share to reach an implied valuation of $1.404 trillion
researchResults.description: The company could end up being worth a hefty $1.404 trillion if its shares list at the top of the price range, on a fully diluted basis.
